decisionReview.resolution: Implementation owns a recovery plan, not a user selection among these technical routes. In the next authorized operation, diagnose the Basic ACR/AVM network-rule mismatch locally and prepare a correction preserving confirmed public TLS/Entra access, disabled admin access, managed identities and SKU; retain Cosmos zone redundancy and East US 2. Preserve historical failure and absent-group evidence without claiming current capacity. Route any capacity/access request, changed target, directory write, resource recreation or retry through the existing scoped authorization path; the prior stop-on-provider/capacity-failure deployment grant is not permission to retry. Reuse saved deploymentContext and applicable exact-scope preparation consent only for operations it actually covers; refresh independent what-if/cost evidence before seeking any required renewed deployment consent. If evidence later establishes that a region, reliability, service, security or material cost change is necessary, present that specific trade-off through its design/scoped consent checkpoint then, rather than choosing it now. Do not implement, make cloud calls, select an original answer, mark a stage complete or approve suitability during this classification job.
